description: Search Marketplace by keyword + city — filters, isLocal/shipsOutsideRadius, opaque cursor (2 credits). Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous nextCursor.

daysSinceListed.description: Facebook calendar-day recency: 1 = since the start of yesterday (not a rolling 24 hours), 7, or 30.

deliveryMethod.description: local_pickup | shipping | all. Shipped listings can appear nationwide outside radiusMiles — use local_pickup for nearby-only; rows expose isLocal / shipsOutsideRadius.

details.description: When true, adds description/condition/coordinates/full photo gallery/seller/distanceMiles — billed as 2 + 2 credits per listing. Default false → flat 2 credits; cover photo is still in image.

limit.description: How many listings to return (1–200). Flat 2 credits when details=false; details=true billed as 2 + 2 per listing.

location.description: Alias of searchLocation. Prefer searchLocation. Either one is required.

maxPrice.description: Maximum price in local currency units.

minPrice.description: Minimum price in local currency units.

q.description: Product or keyword to search Facebook Marketplace for.

radiusMiles.description: Radius in miles: 1,2,5,10,20,40,60,80,100,250,500. Does not exclude nationwide shipped inventory.

searchLocation.description: Search-origin city or place name, e.g. 'Austin, TX'. Required — there is no default city. Echoed on the envelope and inside filters. Not listings[].location. Names that don't resolve to a real place are a definitive 400 UNKNOWN_LOCATION (Facebook would otherwise silently search an unrelated metro) — /v1/facebook/marketplace-location-search finds valid ones.

name: facebook_marketplace_search
